dbSNP: the NCBI database of genetic variation

contrastingEvidence.excerpt: Our observation contrasts with the 2353 SNPs, including 66 out of our 72 SNPs, reported for this DNA stretch covering the ERMAP gene [ 35 ], most of them being rare and often not validated to the extent needed for clinical decision making. Increasing the sample size will result in the confirmation of many or most of the previously reported 2353 SNPs and also the identification of novel SNPs in this DNA stretch.
